historical_pattern.summary: Red-team recon: enumerate the HTTP attack surface from source and a live local listener before any exploit hypothesis is promoted.
references: OWASP Testing Guide: map application attack surface

surface.notes: This campaign maps; it does not claim a vulnerability. SURFACE_MAP JSON is evidence of recon, not of a break.

invariant: Surface mapping must not itself be reported as an exploit.
attacker_capabilities: can speak HTTP to a loopback listener
prerequisites: a local target tree; optional server.py for live probes

oracle.success_means: the mapper printed an exploit token (it must not)
oracle.negative_control: mapper must print OPEN_OK then SURFACE_MAP

severity_rationale: Recon is not a finding. Treating a map as a vulnerability would poison the evidence ladder.
